description: A vintage 1954 black-and-white snapshot showing a group of adults engrossed in a card game around a picnic table outdoors at Pleasant Lake on July 5th. A young shirtless boy stands beside the table looking on. The setting is a shaded, wooded park or campground typical of mid-century American summer leisure activities.
